description: Na₃VCAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.92 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.28 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-59°. There is one shorter (1.72 Å) and three longer (1.73 Å) As-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one V, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃VC trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one V, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂VAs tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃VC trigonal bipyramids and corners with four equivalent ONa₂VAs trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one V, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂VAs trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂VAs tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃VC trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃VC trigonal bipyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one As atom.
